# Unfold

> Unfold is a TypeScript SDK, CLI, and hosted API for parsing and comparing documents across providers through one normalized contract.

Unfold supports two explicit processing modes. Hosted mode sends documents through Unfold infrastructure to the selected provider. Direct or BYOK mode calls the selected provider from the user's environment, so Unfold does not receive the document, key, or result. A comparison sends the document to every selected provider.
